ops.title: Pick cards with a recommended option and no branch (Nov 5 sweep)
ops.body:
# Pick cards: recommended options with no branch named (Nov 5, 1:2x AM)

Read from the main board (session d50e80e8), the ai-oncall board, the present board and both questions-for-you boards: 135 + 8 + 3 + 6 + 2 cards. A card counts as having a branch when its recommended option carries a `build` field with a repo and branch or `none` with a reason, or its words name the branch or its PR. Convert-records cards (6) and edit-fork cards (4) are not counted, per his 12:47 AM rulings. Slack posts, releases and process picks have nothing to build and are not listed.
